scope: B-cells were isolated from mononuclear cells by positive selection using the Miltenyi CD19 Positive Isolation Kit

After purification, cells were washed three times with cold PBS, centrifuged at 1200 rpm for 5 min at 4 °C and resuspended in lysis buffer (100 mM Tris hydrochloride (Tris-HCl) pH 8; 50 mM dithiothreitol (DTT); 2% sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS)) for 5 min at 99 °C followed by sonication on the water at room temperature for 2 min.
The magnetic beads, remaining in the lysate after cell isolation, were removed by centrifugation at 10,000× g RCF for 10 min and transferring supernatant to the new tubes.
